item.title: ००१ हनुमता सागरोल्लङ्घनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

This first chapter of Sundara Kanda describes Hanuma’s preparations to cross the ocean in search of Seetha. Mighty Hanuma’s flight over the ocean is described in a glorious detail. Hanuma’s encountering of Mainaka, Surasa and Simhika form important phases of His flight.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी के द्वारा समुद्रका लङ्घन, मैनाकके द्वारा उनका स्वागत, सुरसापर उनकी विजय तथा सिंहिकाका वध करके उनका समुद्रके उस पार पहुँचकर लंकाकी शोभा देखना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Resolved to trace Sītā abducted by Rāvaṇa along the sky-path of the Cāraṇas, mighty Hanumān strides like a bull and a lion across Mount Mahendra’s mineral-rich slopes.

item.title: ००२ लङ्कापुरीवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

This chapter introduces us to the glorious city of Lanka and Hanuma’s first encounter with it. The geography around the island where Lanka is located is described herein. The chapter also depicts the initial reaction of Hanuma on seeing the city and his initial thoughts about the feasibility of the task of overcoming the Rakshasas and Ravana to reunite Sri Rama with mother Seetha. As the book progresses, we shall see how Hanuma overcomes these thoughts and moves toward achieving this task.

भागसूचना
  1. लंकापुरीका वर्णन, उसमें प्रवेश करनेके विषयमें हनुमान् जी का विचार, उनका लघुरूपसे पुरीमें प्रवेश तथा चन्द्रोदयका वर्णन

item.title: ००३ लङ्कागमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Hanuma faces Lanka, the city of Lanka herself in the form of a demoness.

भागसूचना
  1. लंकापुरीका अवलोकन करके हनुमान् जी का विस्मित होना, उसमें प्रवेश करते समय निशाचरी लंकाका उन्हें रोकना और उनकी मारसे विह्वल होकर उन्हें पुरीमें प्रवेश करनेकी अनुमति देना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Summoning his inner resolve upon the cloud-like peak of Mount Lamba, Hanumān enters Laṅkā by night, beholding a golden-walled citadel rivaling Kubera’s Viṭapāvatī, the Nāgas’ Bhogavatī, and Indra’s Amarāvatī.

item.title: ००४ लङ्कापुरीप्रवेशः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Entering Lanka at night by placing His left foot desiring the destruction of enemies, Hanuma hears various musical instruments being played upon inside. He also observes enemies’ forces and moves towards the royal gynaeceum.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का लंकापुरी एवं रावणके अन्तःपुरमें प्रवेश
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Having vanquished the guardian deity of Laṅkā by his valor, Hanūmān leaps over the rampart without using the gate, plants his left foot first, and traverses the royal highway.
